findings.idNote: Do not confuse this finding with master checklist SEC-01 (server authorization and client isolation).
findings.title: A stale successful authentication read or logout response can replace/erase a newer browser session cookie
productionEvidence: server/access/http.mjs:226 and231 original GET/logout cookie writes
findings.trigger: Request with A awaits service result; later explicit login installs B; delayed successful response A then reissues A or clears the shared cookie.
findings.impact: Silent return to a previously authenticated account where A remains valid, or loss of the newer authenticated session where A was revoked. No unauthenticated credential forgery or cross-client SQL authorization bypass established.

reproduction.kind: real Node HTTP handlers, synthetic service/accounts and response-order cookie model

findings.correction: No authentication Set-Cookie from GET session, successful logout/logout-all or current-device revocation; server-side revocation and explicit login/credential-rotation cookie issuance preserved.
findings.tradeoff: Browser login/rotation cookie persists180days from issuance; server-side SQL expiry retains its existing sliding180-day policy. Inert revoked cookies are refused by the server. No perpetual browser-cookie sliding guarantee.
findings.nativeRegression: Seven additional successful-response cases in tests/browser/session-race.browser.mjs; added but not locally executed.

findings.title: Deployed Nodemailer10.1.1 is in three maintainer-advisory affected ranges; exact10.1.4 candidate upgrade
findings.exposure: Parser-level issues reproduced synthetically; canonicalEmail rejects all3maintainer PoCs before and after upgrade. Explicit SMTP envelope, canonical recipients and fixed templates mean no application leakage path established.
findings.residual: Production still10.1.0 until corrective release; no mail sent and no remote mutation by this agent.

checklist.result: 256-bit hashed invitation, bounded expiry, one-use consumption and user creation in one SQL transaction; issuer revalidated under user/MFA/session locks.
limits: No new real invitation or account was created.

checklist.result: Email verification proof hashed, bounded, single-use; login/active-client gate requires verification and consumed invitation, then administrator approval.
limits: Age declaration is the existing manual admission policy, not an independent age verification integration.

checklist.result: Scrypt bounded; TOTP30-second steps with one-step window and atomic replay barrier; one-use128-bit recovery digests; MFA generation enforced per session; operator recovery revokes existing sessions.
limits: No real TOTP/recovery code was used.

checklist.result: Generic invalid credentials, canonical normalized emails, shared global/network/account budgets before expensive work and parameterized SQL.
limits: Timing equality across every account state is not proven. A11 proxy peer sharing remains conditional and observed host peer topology is unknown.

checklist.result: Independent opaque tokens; role separation; per-device revocation. Login browser cookies retain180-day Max-Age; SQL expiration still renews on valid activity.
limits: Corrective browser cookie lifetime is180days from login/credential rotation; GET no longer slides browser cookie. Runtime1.10.0 still has F-01 until corrective deployment.

checklist.result: Server-side current/all-device revocation retained. Successful logout/revoke no longer clears a newer login cookie on late arrival.
limits: Revoked token can remain as an inert HttpOnly cookie until next login/browser expiry; authorization refuses it.

checklist.result: Renewal CAS binds expected expiry, current actor and freshly sampled SQL-lock clock; calculatedAt reconciles service/store deadline. Invalid or expired sessions cannot renew themselves.
limits: Existing B02 evidence retained; no repeated production renewal.

checklist.result: Current password plus current token/credential-generation/password hash CAS; replacement token inserts atomically; other sessions and reset links revoked; MFA/history encryption keys retained.
limits: Native SQL transaction coverage remains existing1.10.0 proof; targeted local tests are Node24.19.0.

checklist.result: Client-only30-minute reset;256-bit token hash, account/email hash/credential generation binding, single-use consumption with password+device/link invalidation in transaction. Fresh-clock checks after quota/hash/locks.
limits: No real mail send/reset; encrypted outbox transport behavior beyond these stores is parent HTTP/mail scope.

checklist.result: F-01 confirmed on original1.10.0 for stale200 and successful logout/revoke cookie writes; corrected by restricting authentication-cookie issuance to explicit credential-producing flows.
limits: 7before failures,120after targeted passes; Chrome regression added and syntax checked, native execution awaited. Concurrent explicit credential issuance still follows browser last-response-wins; no cross-tab global login sequencing claim.

checklist.result: Strict cookies preserved on external navigation; neutral entry chooses fixed destinations only after fresh role checks. Device transition binds short-lived encrypted ticket to role/origin/nonce/source identity, one-use server record, target account conflict refusal and later-login cancellation.
limits: No physical phone/PWA/OS restoration tested; prior native Chrome two-host evidence only. Explicit handoff is an intentional credential writer.

checklist.result: Current status/role/expiry/credential or MFA generation checked under SQL locks. Active client requires consumed invitation, verified email and approval; expired/pending account sessions cannot grant active message permission.
limits: Every domain operation is reviewed by parent security/messaging owners; this auth subtask does not claim exhaustive inspection of all HTTP domain stores.

checklist.result: Current actor role, credential/MFA generation and conversation membership are rechecked inside transaction locks. Asset ownership uses authorized actor IDs; recipient reads use delivered-message links. Public publication is admin-only with final fresh proof.
limits: No real account used. Existing exact-baseline native SQL proofs are historical, not qualification of1.10.1 corrections. Business owners review remaining domain ACLs.

checklist.result: Client conversation discovery remains bound to its actor ID; role-specific DTO suppresses client lists, admin-only read state and campaign information. Public endpoint returns only independent published snapshot fields.
limits: Client-facing UI/business projections outside these paths are covered by business/frontend owners. No claim of formal whole-program noninterference.

checklist.result: Mutation paths require exact configured Origin, acceptable Fetch Metadata and session-specific CSRF or preauthentication custom header. Host guard rejects ambiguous/duplicate Host and non-origin-form request targets. Arbitrary forwarded headers grant no authority.
limits: Fetch Metadata may be absent for compatible clients; exact Origin and CSRF remain required.

checklist.result: Host-only role cookies use Path=/, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and bounded180-day lifetime. F-01 cookie race corrected locally; only explicit login/credential issuance writes authentication cookies. Text recovery is tab sessionStorage, bounded20entries/64KiB, bound to role/user/session fingerprint and purged on owner changes.
limits: Browser cookie180days from login/rotation; SQL expiry still slides. Revoked cookies remain inert until replacement/expiry. Ordinary drafts expire24hours; uncertain sends keep their immutable request identity until explicit resolution/tab end. Physical shared-device privacy remains user responsibility.

checklist.result: Same-origin CSP excludes inline/eval scripts, objects and frames; no raw HTML/eval sink found by whole-public-JS scan. Reviewed untrusted names/messages/preferences use textContent/rawText. Export HTML escapes five markup characters; archive paths are fixed ASCII names/validated IDs. Navigation models accept closed same-origin destinations.
limits: Static scan is not formal taint analysis; UI owner separately reviews rendering. Video original metadata/codecs are not sanitized as images are.

checklist.result: Fixed-sized buffer identifiers, closed roles and bounded string/page/body validation precede stores. Reviewed SQL uses value placeholders; dynamic identifiers/order fragments derive from fixed internal tables/enums. MariaDB3.5.4 includes relevant escaping fixes. Runtime multipleStatements disabled.
limits: 272 template-query sites inventoried; did not manually prove every site. Business/auth delegated reviews cover their stores. Pool.escape3.5.5 issue has no app call site and runtime wrapper exposes no escape API.

checklist.result: HTTP static files are an explicit allowlist. Private paths reject traversal/separators, unsafe owners/modes and symlinks; hosted Linux directory descriptors pin ancestry. Reads use NOFOLLOW, regular-file/mode/link/inode checks, bounds and integrity tags; publication JSON uses canonical format, exclusive writer lock, CAS and atomic rename with final auth callback.
limits: Trusted same-UID operator/kernel compromise is outside this application boundary. Strict portable mode has a different owner-private ancestry assumption than hosted dirfd mode.

checklist.result: Global/network/token admission and operation slots remain bounded through both service settlement and response completion. JSON/media/video body sizes, active queues, pool/acquisition and header/inactivity/transfer deadlines are bounded. Image decode isolates raster-only sharp with memory/deadline caps.
limits: Known A11: actual provider peer topology unknown; shared reverse-proxy peer can share network budgets. Existing polling/global capacity limits are not a public throughput guarantee. No load attack performed.

checklist.result: Message bodies, images, video blocks and private preferences use AES-256-GCM with distinct context bindings. Preferences derive owner-specific keys and bind version; images bind asset+variant; video binds asset/storage/header/index. Server possesses decryption keys, so this is not end-to-end encryption.
limits: BUS-PREF-01 key-zeroization shutdown race is owned and corrected by business agent, not closed by this report; exact native qualification/deployment required. Public snapshot is deliberately readable and independently published. No private runtime key contents inspected.

checklist.result: Production logs reviewed use fixed errors or bounded operations/release metadata; SMTP logging disabled, database logParam/trace disabled. Static production-path scan found no PEM private keys, AWS access key literals or GitHub token literal patterns. No private customer content was copied into this audit evidence.
limits: This is not exhaustive Git-history/secret-detection or remote filesystem inspection. Private config/permissions and operator artifacts are separately reviewed by release_operator. No claim that all possible secret encodings can be detected statically.

checklist.result: Fresh primary maintainer review detected3Nodemailer advisories affecting deployed10.1.1 despite npm audit0. Candidate exact10.1.4 fixes parsing PoCs; strict application email validation already rejects them. Other direct pins and relevant native/crypto transitives recrossed with primary sources; Node24.22.1 is official current security LTS.
limits: F-02 is dependency hardening, not a demonstrated Jessie recipient leak. Exact59 non-root lock entries have HTTPS registry sources and SHA512 integrity; npm ci succeeded. Not every transitive maintainer advisory page was retrievable;0registry reports never means absence of vulnerabilities. OS/provider and unknown future advisories remain outside scope.

checklist.result: Auth failure and unavailable errors are mapped to public neutral codes; stack/SQL/parser paths are suppressed. Invalid actor versus foreign resource fails closed. Empty/inconsistent service DTOs are revalidated instead of exposing extra properties.
limits: Perfect timing equality across account states is not proven. Authenticated resources may intentionally distinguish404/403/409 within their authorized contract.

checklist.result: A11 remains conditional availability risk: trusted socket.remoteAddress may be the provider proxy and share network budgets among users. No untrusted X-Forwarded-For trust or quota inflation added.
limits: Actual hosted peer sharing unobserved; resolving requires provider contract/minimal approved observation, not assumption.

checklist.result: A10 product facts recrossed with code: no E2E; video originals retain metadata; public snapshot independent of private client preferences; private archives remain user-controlled after download. Legal notice incompleteness remains the explicitly deferred legal scope.
limits: No legal certification. Frontend owner/root must confirm final FR/EN information on candidate and final published snapshot notice.

Other owners cross-domain fixes remain outside this subset decision.
